facts.fact: The report says the Plan National du Numérique 'Horizon 2025' resulted from a validation workshop held in Kinshasa on 3 September 2019, and describes it as a strategic planning document with four pillars (infrastructure, content, application uses, governance and regulation) carrying the head of state's vision; no adopting act is named.
